sentences.text: The application is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioners are the accused 1 and 2 in Crime No.833/2024 of the Kodungallur Police Station,
Thrissur, which is registered against them for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 342, 323, 376(2)(a) and 109 r/w Sec.34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. When the application came up for consideration on 24.10.2024, this Court directed the petitioners to surrender before the Investigating Officer and subject themselves to interrogation.

4. Today, when the application was taken up for consideration, the learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that the Investigating Officer has already filed a report before the jurisdictional court removing the petitioners from the array of accused.
Therefore, the petitioners are no longer accused.
In the light of the above submission, the bail application is dismissed as infructuous.

Sd/-
